# Token budget

Prefer a new chat plus `.ai/HANDOFF.md` over a long thread. Search, then read only what you will change. Do not paste whole files. Do not skip tests or required reads to save tokens.

If `.ai/HANDOFF.md` or `.ai/SESSION.md` exists, use them before exploring. On handoff, update those files and stop.

See `.ai/PROTOCOL.md`.
